name: Chesa Monte
beschreibung: The Hotel Chesa Monte is located in the center of Ischgl, near the valley station of the Silvrettabahn. The surroundings are characterized by the surrounding mountains and the Silvretta Arena ski area. The rooms are furnished in an alpine-modern style and have balconies. Amenities include a wellness area with sauna and steam bath as well as a restaurant. The restaurant serves regional and international dishes. The atmosphere at the hotel is quiet, while the slopes and the center are within walking distance. The hotel is suitable for skiers and guests seeking relaxation who value short distances.
